action_instruction: Checking whether each displayed cart line shows its details
intent: whether each displayed cart line shows an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal

action_params.condition: each displayed cart line on the page shows an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal
action_params.query: whether each displayed cart line shows an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal
action_params.code_js: (() => { const container = el(11)?.closest('.cart-lines') || el(11)?.parentElement; if (!container) return null; const lines = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.cart-line')); return lines.length > 0 && lines.every(line => !!line.querySelector('.cart-line-name')?.textContent.trim() && !!line.querySelector('.cart-line-price')?.textContent.trim() && !!line.querySelector('.cart-line-qty')?.textContent.trim() && !!line.querySelector('.cart-line-subtotal')?.textContent.trim()); })()

assertion_tree.description: each displayed cart line on the page shows an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal

sub_results.description: each displayed cart line on the page shows an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal

assertion_tree.verification: Check every displayed cart line and verify that each one includes an item name, a unit price, a quantity, and a line-item subtotal
